task: Predict MLH1 silencing status in colorectal adenocarcinoma. Classes: No_Silencing vs. Silenced. MLH1-silenced tumors on H&E often show features linked to mismatch repair deficiency, including prominent lymphocytic infiltration, mucinous or medullary morphology, and poor gland formation.

classes.0: Tumor without MLH1 silencing, more often showing conventional colorectal adenocarcinoma morphology.
classes.1: MLH1-silenced tumor with lymphocyte-rich, mucinous, medullary, or poorly differentiated morphology.
